Create Python venv Copy python3 -m venv ~/redenv source ~/redenv/bin/activate pip install -U pip wheel setuptools pip install Red-DiscordBot 2. Create instance Copy redbot-setup redbot redbot --owner YOUR_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners 3. systemd service Copy [Unit] Description=%i redbot After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target [Service] User=ubuntu Group=ubuntu WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redenv/bin/python -O -m redbot redbot --owner YOUR_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners --no-prompt --rpc Restart=on-failure RestartSec=20 [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload sudo systemctl enable red@redbot sudo systemctl start red@redb
